newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrians fear savings losses from euro - survey.
newsitem.headline: Austrians fear savings losses from euro - survey.

text.p: Nearly 50 percent of Austrians believe the conversion to Europe's single currency, scheduled for 1999, will make their savings less valuable, a survey by market research institute Spectra showed on Wednesday.
Nearly 40 percent expect the euro will be a disadvantage for Austria, while just 15 percent think it will bring positive benefits.

Support for the euro was much higher among graduates and academics than in the rest of the population, standing at 33 percent compared with 16 percent, showing that those with a greater knowledge of economics tended to favour the new system.
